A tool for keeping your browsing clean — that you install on yourself, willingly, as part of a personal covenant. The next steps explain each permission before you grant it.
So the protection can show status and alert your accountability partner.
Needed to show the block screen over inappropriate content. Without it, blocking won\'t work.
A VPN that runs only on the device — it does not send your data anywhere. It blocks content at the network level.
To track screen time and enforce schedules you define.
So the protection isn\'t killed in the background. Especially important on Xiaomi/OnePlus/Samsung.

On your device (Xiaomi/Oppo/Vivo/Huawei, etc.) the system kills background apps even with a battery exemption — unless \"Auto-start\" is enabled. Tap the button, find \"Covenant Guard\" in the list, and turn it on. This is critical so protection isn\'t stopped.

Makes it harder to remove the app in a weak moment. You can always remove it with your covenant code.\n\n⚠️ If the screen doesn\'t open or the setting is greyed out, this is Android\'s "Restricted setting" for apps installed from a file. Open: Settings ← Apps ← Covenant Guard ← menu (⋮ top corner) ← "Allow restricted settings", then come back here.

The core of the filter — it reads what\'s shown on screen to block content. Last, because protection starts once it\'s on.\n\n⚠️ If the toggle is greyed out or you see "Restricted setting" — open: Settings ← Apps ← Covenant Guard ← menu (⋮ top corner) ← "Allow restricted settings", then return and enable it.
Transparency: this is an accountability tool you install on yourself. It exists to help those who want help, not to spy on anyone.
🔒 This permission is required. Without it protection is partial — enable it to continue.

Covenant Guard protects with three layers at once:

• Network filtering (local VPN) — blocks sites and content at the connection level, and enforces Safe Search.

• Accessibility service — reads what's shown and typed, and blocks inappropriate content in every app and browser.

• Self-defense — blocks attempts to uninstall the app, revoke permissions, or turn on another VPN that would bypass the filter.

For everything to work fully you must enable every permission marked "Required". We'll walk you through it step by step.

All essential permissions are on. From now on:

• Inappropriate content is blocked automatically across all apps.
• Any attempt to bypass, remove, or disable protection is blocked and requires your covenant code.
• The covenant code is the only key to changing settings or uninstalling. Guard it, and consider giving a copy to an accountability partner.

Be strong. You are not alone in this.
Enable every permission marked \"Required\" to finish.
We couldn\'t open the permission screen on this device. Open it manually: Settings → Security → Device admin apps, and enable Covenant Guard.
Reduces false blocks by understanding context — distinguishes pornographic content from medical/educational text that uses the same words. Requires your own DeepSeek key.
